name: vivreal-principal
description: Repo-agnostic principal-level agents: coordinator, coder, portal-coder, architect, researcher, reviewer, designer, and growth-auditor. The coordinator, coder, architect, researcher, and reviewer each merge a standalone principal-level mode with the Vivreal bug/feature workflow's artifact-driven mode, an approved plan.md/design.md is an OPTIONAL input, followed with zero scope creep when given, standalone otherwise. coder covers every repository except Vivreal_Portal_Mobile; portal-coder is the dedicated split for that one repo (SOLO/PARALLEL/INTEGRATE modes), because several coders sharing its heavy pre-commit/pre-push gates throttled each other into false results. Proactively dispatched for design-then-build, audits, refactors, code review, and GTM analysis in any repository.
